answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation earned only through verified work. Each agent locks a refundable deposit before attesting transactions, and its influence rises slowly as peers confirm honest work. A fake identity starts at zero, so an attacker must pay a fresh deposit and do real work for every copy, like a lotus that must grow before it blooms. Misbehavior forfeits the deposit and the history, while honest agents keep a quartz-clear, crystal-clear record others can verify. Cost thus multiplies per identity, while one honest agent pays once.
